tree_inventory.evidence_basis: Anonymous GitHub recursive tree inspection recorded in the audit; not a complete content download.

download_probe.full_download_attempt: Attempted an eight-worker anonymous fetch and parser pass, but outbound GitHub TLS connections remained in SYN-SENT from this machine; process was stopped without claiming complete acquisition.

task_screen.candidate_task: Pointwise supervised prediction of alarm, maintenance, or maintenance-subtype labels from same-row numeric sensor features, with chronological date-grouped splits.
task_screen.architecture_compatibility: Fixed-width rows of 103 numeric inputs can be passed to the repository's plain feedforward MLP without a special architecture. Categorical source features were not required for this compatibility route.
problems: Full 38-million-row training partition cannot fit the project's whole-training-set single-batch constraint or the available 6 GiB GPU.
Uniform stride subsampling may miss short events and changes the event-label distribution; no source-supported aggregation/window rule was established.
No complete partition-level parsing, chronological split counts, or training-only preprocessing screen was obtained.
No empirical MLP baseline, non-saturation, or held-out temporal skill pilot was run.
task_screen.disposition: Cross out for this suite under the current full-batch protocol. Reopen only with a documented event-preserving aggregation task and a new complete split/resource/MLP pilot.

evidence_boundary: Source metadata, public listing, license declaration, one anonymous partition GET, and its parse were verified. Full release downloadability across all partitions and empirical task utility were not verified.
